summary: # CLO2024.1 - Automatic Generation of PBR Textures ## Introduction to PBR Stickers This video will introduce you to the automatic generation of PBR stickers. ### What are PBR Stickers? PBR stickers, also known as physical stickers, are used to define the interaction of surface properties with simulated light and material in physics-based rendering. They affect the final visual effect. PBR stickers include: - Physical graphics - Simulation graphics - Transparent graphics - Surface roughness graphics - Metal graphics By using PBR stickers, we can achieve a more realistic and intuitive material performance. ## Workflow Enhancements in Qo In the previous version of the software, users could not directly generate PBR stickers in Qo. Instead, they needed to work back and forth between Qo and Photoshop. To streamline the user's workflow, the new version allows for automatic generation of PBR stickers directly within Qo. ### Steps to Generate PBR Stickers 1. Prepare a four-sided continuous texture in advance. 2. Select the material in the object window. 3. Add the texture to the property editor. 4. In the back of the discovery picture, locate the automatically generated image. 5. Click the button to automatically generate a PBR picture. 6. Adjust the intensity of the PBR picture as needed. Additionally, an automatic generation button appears at the back of the discovery picture. Press this button to generate the discovery picture automatically. ### Enhancing the Discovery Effect To make the discovery effect smoother and the simulation effect more natural, turn on the logic editor, open the blurring edge, and adjust the blurring radius. ## Adjusting Simulation Picture Data Next, adjust the simulation picture data by modifying the particle diameter and simulation degree. The transparent picture can also automatically generate PBR stickers using the same operations as the surface rough operation picture. ### Generating Simulation Picture PBR Stickers Let's proceed to generate the PBR sticker for the simulation picture. This process will force the simulation picture load data into the simulation picture. Adjust the data of the simulation picture in the designated area, and also adjust the rough picture data on the surface. ## Working with Metal Pictures Now, open the physical editor for the metal picture. Click on the color switch to adjust the black and white-gray relationship on the bright side. ### Checking Overall Rendering Effect After making these adjustments, check the overall effect of the rendering. The sticker can also automatically generate PBR stickers. In the property editor, click the automated generation button to produce PBR stickers. ### Finalizing Text and Color Open the text editor after the PBR is initiated, and select the relevant options to adjust the background color to achieve the desired effect. Open the blurred edge and adjust the blur radius. Click on the application to turn it off and also adjust the data for any changes. ## Rendering Effects Overview Let's take a look at the rendering effect. In addition to the material and the sticker, the button, the eye, the line of sight, and the accessory can also automatically generate PBR stickers. The overall image remains consistent. ### Customization and Color Adjustments If you desire a different image, the color can vary depending on the user. Using the app, you can see that the color is now uniform. The original picture is completely different. With the app, the color is identical, which leads to pleasing results. If you want to make further changes, the optimization of color allows for communication of colors. If you wish to modify the desired color, click on the object in the top right of the image. The app will display the information on the left, allowing you to move the color here. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching!
